title: Short answers with singular owners
focus: A short affirmative possession reply echoes On. A short negative possession reply is Ei ole. The question already tells us the owner and thing.

exercises.prompt: Reply to “Onko sinulla koira?” with “You do not have it.” Choose a verb reply. koira means “dog”. Address one person.
exercises.explanation: Answer the stated possession meaning: On confirms having it; Ei ole denies having it. Both remain fixed with every owner. An optional Kyllä or Ei can introduce the reply.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Possession question short answers: form or meaning confused

sentenceExplanation.pattern: fixed possession verb reply; owner and thing understood from the question

parts.formation: Keep fixed ei in the negative possession reply.
Ei ole denies possession; it remains fixed for every owner.

answerDiagnostics.category: Possession question short answers: predictable form error
answerDiagnostics.explanation: Olen and en ole describe “I am” and “I am not”. A possession reply echoes fixed on or ei ole.

Answer the stated possession meaning: On confirms having it; Ei ole denies having it. Both remain fixed with every owner. An optional Kyllä or Ei can introduce the reply.
This gives the opposite of the requested possession meaning.
This is a personal “I am” reply; possession echoes fixed on or ei ole.
